description: The loudness envelope of a song.

duration.description: The duration of the song in seconds.

interval.description: The length of audio, in milliseconds, that each value of `levels` covers: 100 for the base resolution, or `100 × N / samples` after reduction, where N is the number of base values. Value i starts at about `i × interval` ms.

samples.description: The number of values in `levels`. This is lower than the requested number of samples only when the request asks for more values than the base resolution holds.

levels.description: One RMS level per slice of the song, in playback order, in dBFS rounded to 2 decimal places, from -120 (silence) to 0 (full scale). After reduction, each value is the highest base value of its slice.
